performance.methodology: Cash-flow-neutral time-weighted return; timestamped flows are subperiod-linked when authenticated before/after equity is available, with settled daily activities otherwise applied at the interval boundary.

note: Performance is time-weighted and normalized to an initial index value of 100. The index reflects mark-to-market account performance, including realized and unrealized P&L, while external deposits and withdrawals are excluded. Index values do not represent actual account equity. Realized Algo P&L includes closed trades only.
